emotional_feel: Calm, warm, emotionally safe, non-judgmental, private, gentle, minimalistic but comforting. Never overwhelming.

typography.strategy: Soft Utility: Rounded Humanist Sans for approachability paired with a highly legible Clean Sans for body. Typeset headings with slightly tight tracking to maintain maturity and avoid feeling overly childish.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Lots of negative space to give emotional 'breathing room'.
layout_and_spacing.containers: Use rounded-3xl for main cards and rounded-full for buttons. Never use sharp edges.
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Mode A (Tetris Grid) for Landing Page hero sections to create visual interest. Mode B (Control Room Grid) but loosely spaced for the 9 Emotional Mode cards.
layout_and_spacing.paddings: p-8 or p-12 for inner card contents. p-4 to p-6 for smaller interactive items.

buttons.primary: bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-slate-700 hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all duration-300 shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all duration-300
buttons.mode_card: flex flex-col items-start p-8 rounded-3xl border transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] cursor-pointer

components.navigation: Crystal Glass variant. bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-100/50. Keeps the header present but unobtrusive.
components.cards: Neumorphism Tactile variant but softer. bg-white rounded-3xl border border-slate-100 shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)] p-8.
components.forms: Use highly customized Shadcn inputs. rounded-2xl border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-100 focus:border-slate-300. No harsh outlines.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Soft lifts (-translate-y-1) and slight shadow expansion. No rapid color flashes.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Slow dissolve or fade-in (opacity 0 to 1 over 500ms).
motion_and_interactions.lists: Staggered entrance animations for quiz questions or reflection wall items.

icons.style: Use stroke-width 1.5 for a delicate, gentle feel. Avoid heavy or filled icons unless for active states.

hero_background.description: Soft pink and blue pastel cloud gradient. Use as a blurred or low-opacity hero background to establish calm.

reflection_intro.description: Tall grass emerging from foggy water. Use on the reflection submission or quiz start page as a grounding visual.

community_wall_bg.description: Gentle blurred lights. Use faintly in the background of the Community Wall to suggest other 'presences' in a safe space.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text inside pastel mode cards uses the -800 weight of the respective color to pass APCA/WCAG contrast against the -50 weight background.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='mode-select-anxiety').
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all fade and lift animations.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the 9 emotional mode cards on the landing page using the 'modes_palette' colors. Each card should feel like a soft, safe entry point.
The quiz interface should present one question at a time or in a very spacious list to avoid overwhelming the user.
Post-quiz reflection page MUST include echo notes (validating user input gently), small coping suggestions, and an anonymous story.
Always display the persistent mental health disclaimer prominently but gently in the footer and on the quiz start screens.
Avoid standard Vercel/Stripe stark aesthetics; lean fully into the Pastel & Soft archetype with generous padding (p-8/p-12) and rounded-3xl corners.
Apply the designated media URLs directly into img tags or background-image styles; DO NOT use placeholders.
